I found the red ball, got to it, and called `rest`. The robot is crouched with motors off.

The ball was in front of the robot, close to its right foot, at roughly 0.3–0.4 m. I estimated that distance from the ball's apparent size, not a measurement. The ball was out of the top camera's view at that point, and it briefly dropped out of the bottom camera too. Its position also shifted between two of my views, so the final approach was a bit uncertain. Battery dropped from 100% to about 28% during the search, and the robot is charging now.
